name: dlab
description: Ten evidence-aware product discovery skills with matching prompts, templates and examples. Learn faster, decide better, then build.

interface.shortDescription: Build the right thing before building it right.
interface.longDescription: A loosely coupled discovery kit for Product Managers, founders and product teams. Ten skills with Guided, Context dump and Best guess modes, editable canvases, evidence labels and human decisions before the next motion.
defaultPrompt: Help me explore this product idea before committing to a build.
Run the Persona motion in context dump mode using my notes.
